about_the_game:
The Journey Never Ends: Leviathan is a mature, turn-based RPG set in the dystopian mega-city of Leviathan—a vast, oppressive world where survival is a daily struggle and morality is a luxury. Ruled by the godlike machine entity Kelzik and the corporate empire, Seven Virtues, none can fight back against their insurmountable might. 

In this dark, atmospheric experience, your journey isn't just about saving the world—it's about not losing yourself to it. Scavenge, fight, and do whatever you can to survive.

Featuring turn-based combat, deep characters, and a narrative that challenges the ethics of the main cast at every turn, The Journey Never Ends: Leviathan invites you to carve out a life in a city that wants to consume you whole.

Features

  • A main story that lasts around 25-30 hours

  • A bunch of side quests 

  • Tons of post game content including a roguelike bonus dungeon that's different every time you enter it

  • A bonus chapter that offers a more elaborate epilogue for those looking for even more story

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence, abuse, sexual content, substance use, profanity, gore, flashing lights, and traumatic themes.
